sections.title: ② 今日文法｜Scarcely/Only after 倒裝、要求式假設語氣、Despite/Although、主詞一致、分詞與篇章連接詞
sections.markdown:
主題：**Scarcely/Only after 倒裝、要求式假設語氣、Despite/Although、主詞一致、分詞與篇章連接詞**

### 規則 1

`Scarcely/Hardly + had + S + p.p. + when + past tense`

> Scarcely had the briefing begun when the alarm sounded.

句首 Scarcely/Hardly 觸發過去完成式倒裝，搭配 when。

### 規則 2

`Only after + clause, auxiliary + S + base verb`

> Only after the audit was completed did the manager approve the payment.

Only after 放句首時，主句倒裝；after 子句本身不倒裝。

### 規則 3

`recommend/require/request that + S + (should) + base verb`

> The auditor recommended that the invoice be corrected.

正式要求或建議後的 that 子句使用原形動詞，被動為 be + p.p.。

### 規則 4

`Despite/In spite of + noun or V-ing; Although + clause`

> Despite receiving the notice, the customer requested clarification.

despite 後接名詞或 V-ing；although 後接主詞與動詞構成的子句。

### 規則 5

`Neither A nor B + verb agreeing with nearer subject`

> Neither the director nor the technicians are available.

動詞通常與最近的主詞 technicians 一致。

### 規則 6

`Past participle reduced relative clause`

> The invoices reviewed yesterday contain several adjustments.

reviewed yesterday = that were reviewed yesterday；名詞承受動作時用過去分詞。

### 規則 7

`However / Therefore / Meanwhile / In addition`

> The portal remains unavailable. Therefore, submissions will be accepted by email.

however 表對比；therefore 表因果；meanwhile 表同時；in addition 表補充。

sections.title: 03 Listening｜Expense Policy — Conditional Release
sections.markdown:
先以 TTS 聽音，不看逐字稿作答；提交後顯示逐字稿與解析。第二輪以 1.1 倍速重聽。

聽力稿：

> Man: Can we send the new expense-claim instructions to all employees today?
> Woman: I would hold off. Payroll has approved the wording, but Legal is still reviewing the reimbursement examples. They expect to finish by three this afternoon. If they approve the examples, we can circulate the instructions before five. Otherwise, we will send them tomorrow morning.
> Man: Then I should not describe today's release as definite?
> Woman: Exactly. Please prepare the email draft, but do not send it until Legal confirms.

sections.title: 04 Listening｜Convention Shuttle — Multiple Constraints
sections.markdown:
先以 TTS 聽音，不看逐字稿作答；提交後顯示逐字稿與解析。第二輪以 1.1 倍速重聽。

聽力稿：

> Woman: We need to transport eighteen delegates to the convention center on Wednesday. They must arrive by eight thirty, at least one vehicle must be wheelchair accessible, and our transport budget is three hundred twenty dollars.
> Man: Route B is cheaper, but its vehicle is not accessible. Route C arrives at eight thirty-five. Route D meets the time and access requirements, but costs three hundred forty-five dollars.
> Woman: Route A seems to be the only option that satisfies everything. Please reserve it and forward the confirmation.

sections.title: 05 Listening｜Pickup Portal — Revised Deadline
sections.markdown:
先以 TTS 聽音，不看逐字稿作答；提交後顯示逐字稿與解析。第二輪以 1.1 倍速重聽。

聽力稿：

> Attention, shipping customers. The pickup-request portal was originally expected to reopen Tuesday at two in the afternoon. Repairs are taking longer, and we now expect it to reopen at four.
> During the outage, you can still consult shipping labels you downloaded earlier, but you cannot submit new pickup requests online.
> For customers whose pickups were scheduled for Tuesday, the confirmation deadline has been extended from Tuesday at five to Wednesday at noon, with no additional fee.
> Automatic reminder emails may still display the original deadline. The updated deadline remains valid.
> For urgent questions, telephone support is available Tuesday from nine until five.

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜Service Agreement, Incident Record and Billing Update
sections.markdown:
限時：**8 分 30 秒**。

### ClearPeak Cloud — Service Agreement

> The standard service fee is $980 per month. Optional backup storage costs $35 per month. An unplanned service interruption lasting more than four hours qualifies the customer for a $150 service credit; an interruption lasting from two hours up to and including four hours qualifies for a $60 credit. Scheduled maintenance announced at least 48 hours in advance does not qualify. Service credits are applied to the following month’s service invoice, not paid as cash refunds. Credits reduce the standard service fee but do not change separately billed optional services.

用途：Monthly charges, outage credits and exclusions

### BlueRiver Design — Incident Record and November Invoice

> On November 9, the customer portal stopped responding at 8:20 A.M. and was restored at 1:05 P.M. The interruption was unplanned; no maintenance notice had been issued. The November invoice lists the $980 standard service fee and $35 backup storage fee, totaling $1,015. Payment is due November 22. The team is reviewing whether a credit should reduce this invoice.

用途：Actual outage and current charges

### ClearPeak Support — Credit Confirmation

> We confirm that the November 9 interruption lasted four hours and forty-five minutes, so a $150 service credit applies. Under your agreement, it will appear on the December invoice, not the November invoice. The November balance remains $1,015. If you wish to discontinue optional backup storage effective December 1, please reply by November 18. With storage discontinued, the December invoice will contain the $980 service fee less the $150 credit and no $35 storage charge. Otherwise, the storage charge continues. We cannot cancel the optional service automatically.

用途：Credit timing, optional service cancellation and next action

### 計算提示
- `08:20→13:05 = 4h45m, qualifies for $150 (>4h).`
- `November: $980+$35=$1,015; December credit does not apply to November.`
- `December without storage: $980−$150=$830.`
- `December with storage: $980−$150+$35=$865.`

sections.title: ⑦ Part 5 仿真題｜15 題
⑧ Day 36 小考
sections.markdown:
正式限時：**5 分鐘**。

### Listening Q36-L1

聽力稿：

> Man: The delivery team can bring twenty-eight tablets Thursday morning. The remaining twelve will arrive Friday afternoon.
> Woman: Thursday’s workshop needs only twenty-five tablets, so we can proceed. Please send the first batch to the training center.

### Listening Q36-L2

聽力稿：

> Thursday’s site tour will begin at nine twenty rather than nine fifty. The meeting point remains the north gate. Participants needing accessibility assistance should email Facilities by two Wednesday afternoon.

### Reading Q36-R1

> Headsets cost $45 each. Orders of 15 or more receive a 10% discount on the headset subtotal only. Shipping costs $30 and is not discounted. The department orders 18 headsets and has a total budget of $780.

### Reading Q36-R2

> General policy: Cancellations after November 10 incur a $40 fee. Provider update: The November 21 seminar has been rescheduled to November 23, so affected registrants may cancel without a fee through November 19. An employee registered for November 21 and requested cancellation on November 18.

sections.title: ⑨ 複習與錯題分類
sections.markdown:
回顧前 **[31, 32, 33, 34, 35] 天**，完成 **[{'prompt': 'No sooner _____ the call ended than the server failed.', 'answer': 'had', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'Only by checking the receipt _____ we identify the charge.', 'answer': 'could', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'Under no circumstances _____ credentials be shared.', 'answer': 'should', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'Had we known, we _____ contacted support.', 'answer': 'would have', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'The number of unresolved tickets _____ fallen.', 'answer': 'has', 'tag': 'AGR'}, {'prompt': 'A number of suppliers _____ responded.', 'answer': 'have', 'tag': 'AGR'}, {'prompt': 'The manager requested that the document _____ updated.', 'answer': 'be', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'I would hold off. → 代表什麼？', 'answer': '建議先不要執行，等待條件確認', 'tag': 'IMP'}, {'prompt': 'waive / refund / credit 的差異？', 'answer': '免收／退還已付費／帳款抵用額', 'tag': 'V'}, {'prompt': '服務公告的舊時間與更新時間衝突時採用？', 'answer': '適用的最新更新時間', 'tag': 'U'}, {'prompt': '25 席享折扣，24 席不享折扣；計算時先確認？', 'answer': '折扣適用門檻及折扣基礎', 'tag': 'CAL'}, {'prompt': 'provided that / in case 的差異？', 'answer': '只要（條件）／以防（預防）', 'tag': 'C'}] 張**複習卡。

先遮答案口頭作答，錯題 24 小時內重做；此為跨日核心觀念複習，非已確認的個人錯題。

錯題標籤：

- `G`：Grammar 文法
- `V`：Vocabulary 字彙
- `L`：Listening 聽力理解
- `P`：Paraphrase 同義改寫
- `I`：Information Integration 資訊整合
- `T`：Timeline 時間順序
- `E`：Exception 特殊例外
- `U`：Updated Information 更新資訊
- `C`：Condition 條件判斷
- `N`：Next Action 下一步
- `POS`：Part of Speech 詞性
- `IMP`：Implication 隱含意圖
- `CAL`：Calculation 計算
- `AGR`：Subject–Verb Agreement 主詞動詞一致
- `BUD`：Budget Constraint 預算限制

sections.title: ⑩ 今日作業
sections.markdown:

- Part 5 仿真 15 題重做一次，記錄每題秒數與錯題標籤。（約 10 分鐘）
- 三組 Listening 先 1.0 倍速再 1.1 倍速，不看逐字稿完成第二輪。（約 25 分鐘）
- Triple Passage 重算停機時長、11 月帳單與 12 月兩種帳單。（約 20 分鐘）
- 正式小考首次限時 5 分鐘；檢討後隔一段時間再做第二次。（約 10 分鐘）

options.B: She recommends waiting before sending the instructions.

questions.prompt: Scarcely _____ the briefing begun when the emergency alert sounded.
questions.explanation: Scarcely had + S + p.p. + when.

questions.prompt: Only after the audit was completed _____ the director authorize payment.
questions.explanation: Only after 句首，主句使用 did + 原形動詞。

questions.prompt: The auditor recommended that the invoice _____ corrected immediately.
questions.explanation: recommend that + S + 原形動詞；被動 be corrected。

questions.prompt: _____ receiving prior notice, several customers requested clarification.
questions.explanation: Despite + V-ing；Although 必須接完整子句。

questions.prompt: Although the service _____ restored, some transactions remained delayed.
questions.explanation: Although 後接完整子句；service 單數，被動 was restored。

questions.prompt: Neither the manager nor the technicians _____ available today.
questions.explanation: 靠近動詞的 technicians 為複數。

questions.prompt: The incident report, along with its attachments, _____ ready for review.
questions.explanation: 主詞 report 為單數，along with 不改變一致性。

questions.prompt: The requests _____ yesterday have already been processed.
questions.explanation: requests 被收到，用過去分詞作後置修飾。

questions.prompt: The team could not restore access immediately. _____, a temporary phone service was introduced.
questions.explanation: 後句為前句造成的應對結果，用 Therefore。

questions.prompt: The invoice has not been paid _____, although it was issued last week.
questions.explanation: 否定現在完成式常用 yet 表示尚未。

questions.prompt: The customer is eligible _____ a credit after the extended outage.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 eligible for。

questions.prompt: The finance team discovered a _____ between the quotation and the invoice.
questions.explanation: 冠詞 a 後接單數名詞 discrepancy。

questions.prompt: Please notify us _____ the scheduled maintenance is postponed.
questions.explanation: 後接完整條件子句用 if。

questions.prompt: The service credit will be _____ from next month’s standard fee.
questions.explanation: 被動 will be deducted。

questions.prompt: No later _____ Friday should the updated invoice be submitted.
questions.explanation: 固定片語 no later than。

questions.prompt: Scarcely _____ the orientation begun when the fire alarm sounded.
questions.explanation: Scarcely had the orientation begun when ...

questions.prompt: The committee recommended that the software _____ tested before release.
questions.explanation: recommend that + S + be tested。

questions.prompt: Despite _____ the revised notice, several participants arrived late.
questions.explanation: Despite 後接 V-ing。

questions.prompt: Neither the coordinator nor the technicians _____ on duty this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 靠近動詞的 technicians 是複數。

questions.prompt: How many tablets can be delivered Thursday morning?
questions.explanation: The first shipment contains 28 tablets.

questions.prompt: What does the woman imply about Thursday’s workshop?

options.B: It can proceed using the first shipment.

questions.explanation: 28 available ≥ 25 needed; workshop can proceed.

questions.explanation: New time is 9:20 A.M.; 9:50 was the old time.

How much of the $780 budget remains?
